Europubhealth+ is a two-year Erasmus Mundus public health master delivered by eight European universities, with seven specialisation tracks from biostatistics to health-systems governance. For the 2027-2029 intake the scholarship deadline is 8 January 2027 at 13:00 CET, and self-funded applicants have until 24 March 2027.

Programme Highlights

  • Eight-university consortium with seven second-year specialisations across Europe
  • January scholarship round with results in mid-March; self-funded until 24 March 2027
  • Double master degrees from the two host universities plus the EPH certificate
  • Trilingual options (English, Spanish, French) across the pathways

Who Should Apply

Graduates in health sciences, medicine, biology, social sciences, economics and law with public-health interest are eligible; booking language tests early is explicitly advised because results must reach the committee before review.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus Excellence scholarships for selected students in the January round: participation costs plus monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply on the Kraków-hosted eMundus portal before 8 January 2027 (13:00 CET) for scholarship consideration. Key deadline information: 8 January 2027 (13:00 CET, Erasmus Mundus scholarship round; results mid-March). Self-funded round until 24 March 2027.

  • Official application page (verified link)

About Europubhealth+ Consortium

The Europubhealth+ consortium groups eight European universities to deliver the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in public health, coordinated between Rennes, Granada, Sheffield and partner campuses since 2006.

Official website: https://www.europubhealth.org

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 8 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
